entities.name: Weeping Bosk
entities.description: Secluded grove by the Wanderbrine River, home of Colfenor, where Rhys trained in yew magic.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Young elf who trained in yew magic under Colfenor and joined the Wilt-Leaf.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: Treefolk, Colfenor the Red Yew, home of the Weeping Bosk for hundreds of years.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Faerie queen whose birth was the last such spectacle at Glen Elendra.

events.summary: Rhys trains in yew magic with Colfenor, who is disappointed when Rhys chooses to serve the Wilt-Leaf.
events.quote: Colfenor at first delighted in his abilities, but then became disappointed when Rhys decided to use his magic skills in service of the Wilt-Leaf instead of fostering the treefolk seedlings.

events.summary: Colfenor dies in Kinscaer and the bosk begins growing buds that burst open with faeries.
events.quote: the bosk started growing rows of green vine stalks carrying growing buds.

relations.quote: where Rhys received his yew magic training from Colfenor
